quests.title: Lantern Night
quests.summary: A wounded courier, a stolen letter, and three strangers who want it back.

steps.text: Speak with Brannoc, the innkeeper
See to the wounded courier (Medicine)
Find out who wants the courier's letter

quests.title: The Old Mine
quests.summary: Someone is digging in the old mine. The road there runs through goblin country, and Grisk Two-Teeth holds the missing miners.

steps.text: Take the Ashford road toward the old mine (F2)
Get past the goblin warren's gate (F3)
Deal with Grisk Two-Teeth (F4: fight, sneak or trade)
Bring the missing miners out of the warren
Get past the diggers at the mine mouth (F5)
Cross the Deep Seam (F6)
Find the way into the old Ammarindar halls
Face Brother Ulric in the sunken shrine (F7)
Climb back to the mine mouth with the shard

quests.title: Something in the Cellar
quests.summary: Brannoc has heard scratching under the floorboards for a week.

steps.text: Ask Brannoc about the scratching
Clear Brannoc's cellar
Follow the old tunnel under the cellar

quests.title: The Herbalist's Granddaughter
quests.summary: Old Wynn's granddaughter Tamsin has gone into the Ashwood after the Hollow Star's recruiters.

steps.text: Hear Old Wynn out at the Drowned Lantern
Track Tamsin through the Ashwood
Find the recruiters' camp: bring Tamsin home, or let her choose

quests.title: The Mill at Night
quests.summary: Shadows move inside Varrow's Mill like a family sitting down to dinner.

steps.text: Investigate Varrow's Mill after dark
Drive out the shadows
Find Lysa Varrow's locket and lay her ghost to rest

quests.title: The Goblin Who Stayed
quests.summary: A goblin scout named Wix owes you his life, and he has opinions about pie.

steps.text: Spare the goblin scout on the road
Settle the matter of the stolen pies with Brannoc
Bring Wix's clan luck-stone out of the warren

awards.reason: Faced down the Grey Company (F1: talking past a fight is worth the same XP, D16)
Rescued the miners from the goblin warren
Found the way into the old Ammarindar halls
Slipped past the warren gate (F3: avoiding a fight is worth the same XP, D16)
Traded with Grisk instead of fighting (F4, D16)
Talked the diggers at the mine mouth down (F5, D16)
Stole the luck-stone back without a fight (D16)
Discovery: the old dwarf tunnel under the Lantern
Discovery: Wix's warning that the mountain is breathing
Discovery: read the Ammarindar runes in the halls
Discovery: read the signs of a young red dragon
